name: ai-discoverability-audit
description: Audits any website for AI-discoverability and on-site-engagement problems, producing structured findings in the hardened finding contract format.

skills.name: audit-orchestrator
skills.description: Top-level orchestrator: accepts a domain, runs site-acquisition and analysis skills in sequence, deduplicates and scores findings, and emits the final audit report.

skills.name: site-acquisition
skills.description: Crawls and renders the target website within budget constraints, producing a normalized page corpus and crawl manifest for downstream analysis skills.

skills.name: machine-readability-audit
skills.description: Audits the corpus for structured-data, robots-directive, and metadata gaps that degrade AI agent discoverability.

skills.name: trust-signals-audit
skills.description: Audits the corpus for trust, freshness, and corroboration signals (T1 staleness, T2 fact inconsistencies, T3 entity ambiguity, and T4 missing contact/authorship).
